dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: The tastiest food in the world, get it here! Come, dear friend, would you like some?

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: Over here, dear. Take your time reading it — tell me what you'd like, whenever you like.

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: Friend, they call me the face of street food.

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: If I were to be given some high-flown title like some great figure, they would call me "Fish-and-Chips Louis." Simple and elegant, no?

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: Ah, you've come to the right man, friend. We make the best fish and chips in the world here!

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: Fish and chips for breakfast, to energize you in the morning. Fish and chips for tea, beloved by all the children...

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: And do I need to mention fish and chips for a walk through town? Their crispness and fragrance are praised by the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol Captain and seagulls alike!

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: Why, I cannot imagine what would become of Fontaine if fish and chips did not exist!

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: If you should ever want some fish and chips, I shall see you then.

dialogues.speaker: Louis
dialogues.text: Heh. Dear, let me pack this up for you. You'll know it once you take a bite.
